account_status.active.empty.defaultMessage: Keine Maßnahmen gegen dein Konto in Kraft
account_status.active.empty.description: Shown when no moderation action is in effect on the user's account.

account_status.active.empty.description.defaultMessage: Wenn die Moderation eine Maßnahme gegen dein Konto ergreift, erscheint sie hier mit ihrem Grund und dem Zeitpunkt, an dem sie endet.
account_status.active.empty.description.description: Under the heading shown when no moderation action is in effect on the user's account.

account_status.active.title.description: Heading of the account status page's region with the moderation actions in effect now.

account_status.appeal.cancel.description: Button that closes the appeal dialog without appealing.

account_status.appeal.characters_left.defaultMessage: {count, plural, one {# Zeichen übrig} other {# Zeichen übrig}}
account_status.appeal.characters_left.description: Character count of the appeal field. {count} is the number of characters left.

account_status.appeal.characters_over.defaultMessage: {count, plural, one {# Zeichen zu viel} other {# Zeichen zu viel}}
account_status.appeal.characters_over.description: Character count of the appeal field when it is over the limit. {count} is the number of characters too many.

account_status.appeal.closed.defaultMessage: Die Frist für einen Einspruch gegen diese Maßnahme endete am {date}.
account_status.appeal.closed.description: Shown instead of the appeal button when the time to appeal a moderation action has passed. {date} is a formatted date and time.

account_status.appeal.confirm.descriptio.defaultMessage: Die Moderation prüft „{kind}“ vom {date} erneut und teilt dir ihre Entscheidung in einer Benachrichtigung mit. Du kannst gegen eine Maßnahme nur einmal Einspruch einlegen und den Einspruch nach dem Absenden nicht mehr ändern.
account_status.appeal.confirm.descriptio.description: Description of the dialog that appeals a moderation action. {kind} is what the action does, as the server names it; {date} is when it was taken, a formatted date and time.

account_status.appeal.confirm.title.description: Question that titles the dialog that appeals a moderation action.

account_status.appeal.decided_at.description: Term of the user's appeal of a moderation action: when the moderators decided it.

account_status.appeal.decision_reason.description: Term of the user's appeal of a moderation action: the moderators' explanation of their decision.

account_status.appeal.failed.defaultMessage: Der Einspruch konnte nicht gesendet werden: {reason}
account_status.appeal.failed.description: In the appeal dialog when sending the appeal failed. {reason} is why, from the server.

account_status.appeal.open.description: Button that opens the appeal of a moderation action.

account_status.appeal.open_of.defaultMessage: Einspruch gegen die Maßnahme vom {date} einlegen
account_status.appeal.open_of.description: Accessible name of the button that opens the appeal of a moderation action. {date} is when the action was taken, a formatted date and time.

account_status.appeal.send.description: Button in the appeal dialog that sends the appeal.

account_status.appeal.sent.defaultMessage: Du hast Einspruch gegen „{kind}“ eingelegt. Die Moderation teilt dir ihre Entscheidung in einer Benachrichtigung mit.
account_status.appeal.sent.description: Status shown after the user appealed a moderation action. {kind} is what the action does, as the server names it.

account_status.appeal.state.overturned.description: State of an appeal after which the moderators lifted the action.

account_status.appeal.state.pending.description: State of an appeal that awaits the moderators' decision.

account_status.appeal.state.upheld.description: State of an appeal after which the moderators kept the action.

account_status.appeal.submitted_at.description: Term of the user's appeal of a moderation action: when the user sent it.

account_status.appeal.text.description: Term of the user's appeal of a moderation action: what the user wrote.

account_status.appeal.text.description.defaultMessage: Schreibe, was die Moderation wissen sollte. Sie sieht, was du hier schreibst.
account_status.appeal.text.description.description: Help text under the field of an appeal.

account_status.appeal.text.label.defaultMessage: Warum sollte die Moderation die Maßnahme überdenken?
account_status.appeal.text.label.description: Label of the field where the user writes why the moderators should reconsider an action.

account_status.appeal.text.required.defaultMessage: Gib an, warum die Moderation die Maßnahme überdenken sollte
account_status.appeal.text.required.description: Error of the appeal field when it is empty or has white space only.

account_status.appeal.text.too_long.description: Error of the appeal field when it has too many characters. {max} is the limit.

account_status.appeal.title.description: Heading of the appeal part of a moderation action on the user's account.

account_status.appeal.unavailable.defaultMessage: Gegen diese Maßnahme ist kein Einspruch möglich.
account_status.appeal.unavailable.description: Shown instead of the appeal button when a moderation action cannot be appealed.

account_status.appeal.until.defaultMessage: {days, plural, one {Du kannst einmal Einspruch einlegen, innerhalb von # Tag (bis {date}).} other {Du kannst einmal Einspruch einlegen, innerhalb von # Tagen (bis {date}).}}
account_status.appeal.until.description: Above the button that appeals a moderation action. {days} is the time left to appeal, rounded up to whole days; {date} is the deadline, a formatted date and time. The server's status page says the same without the date.

account_status.ends_in.defaultMessage: {days, plural, one {Endet in # Tag} other {Endet in # Tagen}}
account_status.ends_in.description: Under a moderation action in effect on the user's account: when it ends. {days} is the time left, rounded up to whole days. The server's status page says the same.

account_status.until_lifted.defaultMessage: Gilt, bis die Moderation sie aufhebt
account_status.until_lifted.description: Under a moderation action in effect on the user's account that has no end date. The server's status page says the same.

account_status.no_end.description: Under a moderation action in effect on the user's account whose kind does not last for a time, such as a warning: says that the missing end date is not an omission.

account_status.expires_at.description: Term of a moderation action on the user's account: when it ends.

account_status.expires_at.none.description: Value of the end of a moderation action that lasts until a moderator lifts it.

account_status.issued_at.description: Term of a moderation action on the user's account: when it was taken.

account_status.lifted_at.description: Term of a moderation action on the user's account: when a moderator lifted it.

account_status.more.description: Button under a list of moderation actions that loads more of them.

account_status.past.empty.description: Shown when no moderation action on the user's account has ended.

account_status.past.title.description: Heading of the account status page's region with the moderation actions that ended (expired or lifted).

account_status.posts.loading.description: Accessible label of the spinner while a post that a moderation action acted on loads.

account_status.posts.missing.defaultMessage: Dieser Beitrag ist gelöscht oder kann nicht angezeigt werden.
account_status.posts.missing.description: In place of a post that a moderation action acted on and that cannot be shown, such as a deleted one.

account_status.posts.title.description: Heading of the posts that a moderation action on posts acted on.

account_status.public_reason.description: Term of a moderation action on the user's account: the moderators' explanation to the user.

account_status.public_reason.none.description: Value of the moderators' explanation of an action when they gave none.

account_status.reason_category.description: Term of a moderation action on the user's account: the kind of reason the moderators gave.

account_status.state.active.description: State of a moderation action that is in effect now.

account_status.state.expired.description: State of a moderation action that ended at its end time.

account_status.state.lifted.description: State of a moderation action that a moderator lifted.

account_status.title.description: Heading and document title of the account status page, and its entry in the list of settings pages.
